nodes.name: Cleaning of SS meshes
nodes.procedure: First, the 316 L SS meshes of different mesh numbers (100, 500, 1000, 1600, 2000 and 2800 mesh) were cut to the size of 0.5 × 0.5 cm² for cleaning. The cut SS meshes were then ultrasonically treated with 1 M HCl, ethanol and deionized water for 30 min each to avoid the influence of impurities on the surface of the samples, which will be used directly as the working electrodes in further study.

nodes.description: HER stability test after 2000 CV cycles in 0.5 M H2SO4
nodes.source_text: the stability of the 316 L SS-1600 is reflected by comparing the LSV curves of the sample before and after 2000 cycles of CV tests with a scan rate of 100mVs−1. It can be seen that, after 2000 cycles, the LSV curve of 316 L SS-1600 substantially coincides with the initial LSV curve

nodes.characterization_summary: The lattice structure of 316 L SS-1600 shows characteristic peaks of austenite (γ phase) at 2θ = 43.8°, 50.9° and 74.8° corresponding to (111), (200) and (220) crystal faces (PDF#33-0397).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The lattice structure of 316 L SS-1600 was studied by XRD. As shown in Fig. 1, the XRD pattern of 316 L SS shows the same characteristic peaks as austenite, which is called the γ phase.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM reveals different wire diameters and weaving configurations for different mesh numbers: 100-mesh ~94 μm, 500-mesh ~29 μm, 1000-mesh 66 μm and 45 μm, 1600-mesh 66 μm and 51 μm, 2000-mesh ~39 μm, 2800-mesh ~24 μm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The morphology of 316 L SS with different mesh numbers was analyzed by SEM. Various SS wires were woven together to form SS meshes.

properties.description: High-resolution scanning electron microscopy image showing nanostructured material with bundled, twisted fibrillar or rod-like morphology

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS shows 316 L SS-1600 composed mainly of Fe (45.33 at%), Ni (9.19 at%), Cr (13.55 at%), Mo (1.26 at%), C (30.67 at%) with atomic ratio Fe:Ni:Cr:Mo = 1:0.20:0.30:0.03; 316 L SS-2800 shows Fe:Ni:Cr:Mo = 1:0.27:0.26:0.02.
nodes.evidence_snippet: At the same time, the composition and element content of SS were analyzed by EDS measurement. EDS test was performed on 316 L SS-1600 (Fig. 3a) and 316 L SS-2800 (Fig. 3b).
